hook_text: Ice, a clay pot, a paper pillar and a pylon. One term, one story. Can you link them all?
clip_script: Term 2 in one minute! Solids keep their shape, liquids pour, gases spread. Heat it: melt, evaporate. Cool it: condense, freeze. The Sun lifts water up, clouds form, rain falls, round and round. Sand becomes glass, clay becomes mugs, wood becomes paper. Waterproof raincoat, absorbent towel. Fold paper and it holds coins. Roll a circle pillar and it holds books. Add a triangle and the frame stops wobbling. Matter and Materials: done!
visual_style: Whiteboard poster wall with four panels filling in one by one: states of matter, the water cycle, raw to manufactured materials, and strong shapes and frames.
mood: Confident and quick, like a final practice before the big match.
pacing: One panel at a time with its key facts and one common mistake, then the pocket summary.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and explain the water cycle to someone at home in under a minute.
